reasoning_steps: The text introduces classifications and specific types of amino acids that are not yet represented in the existing ontology.
New classes for amino acid classifications based on structure, polarity, metabolic fates, and position of -NH2 need to be added.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An AliphaticAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with a side chain that consists of carbon atoms in open chains or unbranched rings.
classes.comment: Includes amino acids like glycine, alanine, valine, leucine, and isoleucine.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A HydroxylGroupContainingAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with a hydroxyl group (-OH) attached to its side chain.
A SulphurContainingAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with a sulfur-containing side chain.
A BasicAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with a side chain that has basic properties.
An AromaticAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with a side chain that contains aromatic rings.
An IminoAcid is an AminoAcid with a side chain that contains an imino group (=NH) instead of the usual amino group (-NH2).
An AlphaAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with both the amino and carboxyl groups attached to the alpha carbon.
classes.comment: All naturally occurring amino acids are α-amino acids.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A BetaAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with the amino group attached to the beta carbon.
A GammaAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with the amino group attached to the gamma carbon.
A PurelyKetogenicAminoAcid is an AminoAcid that can only be metabolized to produce ketone bodies.
A KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid is an AminoAcid that can be metabolized to produce both ketone bodies and glucose.
classes.comment: Includes lysine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, tyrosine, and tryptophan.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid is an AminoAcid that can only be metabolized to produce glucose or glycogen.
classes.comment: Includes alanine, aspartic acid, glutamic acid, etc.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A NonPolarAminoAcid is an AminoAcid with a side chain that does not have any charge.
classes.comment: Includes alanine, leucine, valine, methionine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, and proline.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PolarAminoAcidWithNoCharge is an AminoAcid with a side chain that has polar groups but no charge.
classes.comment: Includes glycine, serine, threonine, cysteine, glutamine, asparagine, and tyrosine.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PolarAminoAcidWithPositiveCharge is an AminoAcid with a side chain that has a positive charge.
A PolarAminoAcidWithNegativeCharge is an AminoAcid with a side chain that has a negative charge.
classes.comment: Includes aspartic acid and glutamic acid.
